apps.name: VS Code
apps.install: Copy apps/vscode/ into ~/.vscode/extensions/rfs-cyclorama-dawn and pick Color Theme
installSteps: Copy `apps/vscode/` to `~/.vscode/extensions/rfs-cyclorama-dawn` (or `~/.cursor/extensions/rfs-cyclorama-dawn`).

Switch themes anytime from **Settings -> Appearance & Behavior -> Appearance -> Theme**.

apps.name: Windows Terminal
apps.install: Paste scheme into settings.json "schemes" array + dot-source PSReadLine .ps1
installSteps: Open Windows Terminal Settings (Ctrl+,) and select Open JSON file to open settings.json.
Paste one variant from cyclorama-dawn.json (or all three from schemes.json) into the "schemes" array, then set "colorScheme": "Cyclorama Dawn" in profiles.defaults.
Optional: dot-source psreadline/cyclorama-dawn.ps1 in your PowerShell $PROFILE (PSReadLine 2.2+) for matching command-line syntax highlighting.

installSteps: Copy `Cyclorama Dawn.xaml`, `Cyclorama Steel.xaml`, and `Cyclorama Day.xaml` into `%APPDATA%\FlowLauncher\Themes\`.
Restart Flow Launcher and open **Settings -> Appearance -> Theme**.
Select **Cyclorama Dawn**, **Cyclorama Steel**, or **Cyclorama Day**.

variants.name: Cyclorama Dawn
variants.tagline: Matte #050507 spotlight dialog with crisp #62646D frame, Beacon Orange caret/matches, and Steel Blue clock readout.
variants.copySnippet:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<ResourceDictionary xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
                    xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
    <ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
        <ResourceDictionary Source="pack://application:,,,/Themes/Base.xaml" />
    </ResourceDictionary.MergedDictionaries>
    <SolidColorBrush x:Key="ItemSelectedBackgroundColor" Color="#FF38241C" />
    <Style x:Key="WindowBorderStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Border}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F5050507" />
        <Setter Property="BorderBrush" Value="#FF62646D" />
        <Setter Property="BorderThickness" Value="1" />
        <Setter Property="CornerRadius" Value="10" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="WindowStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Window}">
        <Setter Property="Background" Value="#F5050507" />
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF4F5F8" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="QueryBoxStyle" BasedOn="{StaticResource BaseQueryTextBoxStyle}" TargetType="{x:Type TextBox}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF4F5F8" />
        <Setter Property="CaretBrush" Value="#FFF06E2B" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="ItemTitleStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFD6D8E0" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="ItemTitleSelectedStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFF4F5F8" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="ItemSubTitleSelectedStyle" TargetType="{x:Type TextBlock}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFFF9254" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="HighlightStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Run}">
        <Setter Property="Foreground" Value="#FFFF9254" />
    </Style>
    <Style x:Key="SeparatorStyle" TargetType="{x:Type Rectangle}">
        <Setter Property="Fill" Value="#FF2A2C35" />
    </Style>
</ResourceDictionary>

apps.name: Windows 11
apps.install: Run install-cyclorama-dawn.ps1 or double-click .theme
installSteps: Run `.\install-cyclorama-dawn.ps1` (or `steel` / `day`) from `apps/windows/` — it auto-detects `1080p` vs `4k` (`-Resolution auto|1080p|4k`), saves a one-time registry backup to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\rfs-themes\windows\backup-pre-rfs.reg`, installs wallpapers & `.theme` files, sets the 32-byte `AccentPalette`, and refreshes Windows live.
Pass `-TintTaskbar` if you want Start/Taskbar tinted with the accent color (off by default so the taskbar stays matte `#050507` or Alabaster `#F5F7F9`).
Switch between **Cyclorama Dawn**, **Cyclorama Steel**, and **Cyclorama Day** anytime from **Settings -> Personalization -> Themes**, or double-click `backup-pre-rfs.reg` to revert.
